Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises precisely at 6:00 AM to hoe the soil around his tomato plants while the morning mist still clings to the backyard. After breakfast, he settles into the sunroom with Monday’s paper, carefully repairing a loose drawer handle on the kitchen sideboard before heading to bed at 10:00 PM to keep his rhythm intact.

Martha.day_scenario: Martha wakes at 6:30 AM to sip her chamomile tea on the back porch, keeping a watchful eye on the cardinals gathering at the feeder. She spends the afternoon sorting the spice aisle in the pantry and stitching a new section of her blue quilt, leaving her sewing nook immaculate while the living room armchair retains its usual stack of magazines before she turns in at 9:30 PM.
